name: Naming Conventions
description: Enforce consistent naming conventions across the codebase

rules.name: ViewModel Naming
rules.message: ViewModel classes must end with 'ViewModel' suffix

rules.name: View Naming
rules.message: SwiftUI View structs should end with 'View' suffix

rules.name: Repository Naming
rules.message: Repository implementations must end with 'Repository' suffix

rules.name: Service Naming
rules.message: Service implementations should end with 'Service' or 'ServiceImpl' suffix

rules.name: Protocol Naming
rules.description: Protocols should use descriptive names (avoid 'Protocol' suffix)
rules.message: Avoid 'Protocol' suffix in protocol names, use descriptive names instead
